faults.fault: At 1.8x width the cabinet's wood grain is visibly stretched and streaked across the broadened front, and at 1.6x height the extra body height went into a blank smeared wood panel between the title strips and the lower grille, leaving the grille arch and controls clustered at the top with a large empty stretch where image 1 shows continuous artwork. The body texture is tiling straight across the enlarged panel instead of filling it.

In the 1.6x taller render the bubbler columns do run longer correctly, but the stretched body panel behind them makes the tubes read as floating strips on blank wood rather than set into a continuous cabinet face; this resolves once the background fills the added height instead of smearing.
